correctness.rationale: Exact proof: even-child root structure gives DU=0 and finite height U^(h+1)=D^(h+1)=0. Every noncommutative word with DU factor vanishes, so A^k=sum U^aD^b. Direct evaluation on impulses gives the nonzero last state at time h+ell and extinction one step later. Terminal powers have ranks 1 and 2, independently of tree branching; rank-nullity gives all claimed tail counts, including h=0 special case. Direct adjacency simulator checks 409 eligible unlabeled trees plus 30 combs; separate operator simulator checks 250 irregular trees. Tests do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural structural family characterized intrinsically by a unique even-degree vertex, rather than arbitrary slices. It exhibits an exact full-state dynamical classification with sharp pulse-time dependence on distance from the unique even-degree vertex, precisely quantified final transient layers, and a bounded-degree comb whose extinction time exceeds graph diameter by unbounded h. This clarifies how parity cancellations, not mere propagation distance, control transient clocks; applications to finite field network dynamics are plausible.
